name: Abyssalite
description: (Ab) Abyssalite is a resilient, crystalline element.

name: Algae
description:
Algae is a cluster of non-motile, single-celled lifeforms.

It can be used to produce Oxygen when used in an Oxygen Diffuser.

name: Aluminum
description:
(Al) Aluminum is a low density Metal.

It has high Thermal Conductivity and is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Aluminum Ore
description:
Aluminum ore, also known as Bauxite, is a sedimentary rock high in metal content.

It can be refined into Aluminum.

name: Amber
description: Amber is a Solid organic composite of Resin and Fossil.

name: Basalt
description: Basalt is a natural volcanic rock that forms when Magma cools rapidly.

name: Bitumen
description: Bitumen is a sticky viscous residue left behind from Petroleum production.

name: Bleach Stone
description:
Bleach stone is an unstable compound that emits unbreathable Chlorine Gas.

It is often used in Hygienic processes.

name: Brackwax
description: Brackwax is a Solid byproduct of Brackene.

name: Brine Ice
description:
Brine Ice is a natural, highly concentrated solution of Salt dissolved in Water and frozen into a Solid state.

It can be used in desalination processes, separating out usable salt.

name: Ceramic
description:
Ceramic is a hard, brittle material formed from heated Clay.

It is a reliable Construction Material.

name: Cinnabar Ore
description:
(HgS) Cinnabar Ore, also known as mercury sulfide, is a conductive Metal that can be refined into Mercury.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Clay
description:
Clay is a soft, naturally occurring composite of stone and soil that hardens at high Temperatures.

It is a reliable Construction Material.

name: Coal
description:
(C) Coal is a combustible fossil fuel composed of carbon.

It is useful in Power production.

name: Cobalt
description: (Co) Cobalt is a Refined Metal made from Cobalt Ore.

name: Cobalt Ore
description:
(Co) Cobalt Ore is a blue-hued Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Copper
description:
(Cu) Copper is a conductive Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Copper Ore
description:
(Cu2O) Copper Ore is a conductive Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Coquina
description:
Coquina is a brittle Solid mineral made up of the calcified remains of aquatic invertebrates.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Corallium
description:
Corallium is a dense coral primarily composed of (CaCO3) Lime.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Corium
description:
A radioactive mixture of nuclear waste and melted reactor materials.

Releases Nuclear Fallout gas.

name: Crushed Ice
description: (H2O) A slush of crushed, semi-solid ice.

name: Crushed Rock
description: Crushed Rock is Igneous Rock crushed into a mechanical mixture.

name: Depleted Uranium
description:
(U) Depleted Uranium is Uranium with a low U-235 content.

It is created as a byproduct of Enriched Uranium and is no longer suitable as fuel.

name: Diamond
description:
(C) Diamond is industrial-grade, high density carbon.

It is very difficult to excavate.

name: Dirt
description:
Dirt is a soft, nutrient-rich substance capable of supporting life.

It is necessary in some forms of Food production.

name: Enriched Uranium
description:
(U) Enriched Uranium is a refined substance primarily used to Power potent research reactors.

It becomes highly Radioactive when consumed.

name: Fertilizer
description:
Fertilizer is a processed mixture of biological nutrients.

It aids in the growth of certain Plants.

name: Fossil
description:
Fossil is organic matter, highly compressed and hardened into a mineral state.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Frozen Brackene
description: Frozen Brackene is Brackene frozen into a Solid state.

name: Frozen Mucin
description: Frozen Mucin is a chunk of Mucin cooled to a Solid state.

name: Frozen Ovolene
description: Frozen Ovolene is Ovolene frozen into a Solid state.

name: Frozen Phyto Oil
description: Frozen Phyto Oil is thick, slippery Slime extract, frozen into a Solid state.

name: Frozen Squid Ink
description: Frozen Ink is Squid Ink cooled to a Solid state.

name: Fullerene
description: (C60) Fullerene is a form of Coal consisting of spherical molecules.

name: Galena
description: (PbS) Galena is a raw Metal Ore primarily composed of Lead with Sulfur impurities.

name: Genetic Ooze
description:
(DuPe) Ooze is a slurry of water, carbon, and dozens and dozens of trace elements.

Duplicants are printed from pure Ooze.

name: Glass
description: Glass is a brittle, transparent substance formed from Sand fired at high temperatures.

name: Gold
description:
(Au) Gold is a conductive precious Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Gold Amalgam
description:
Gold Amalgam is a conductive amalgam of gold and mercury.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Granite
description:
Granite is a dense composite of Igneous Rock.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Graphite
description:
(C) Graphite is the most stable form of carbon.

It has high thermal conductivity and is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Gum Wood
description:
Gum Wood can be processed at the Plant Pulverizer to yield Latex, which is essential for Rubber production.

It can also be used for Heat and Power, or as a Construction Material.

name: Ice
description: (H2O) Ice is clean water frozen into a Solid state.

name: Igneous Rock
description:
Igneous Rock is a composite of solidified volcanic rock.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Insulite
description: Insulite reduces Heat Transfer and is composed of recrystallized Abyssalite.

name: Iridium
description: (Ir) Iridium is a firm and highly conductive Metal that can withstand extreme  Heat.

name: Iron
description: (Fe) Iron is a common industrial Metal.

name: Iron Ore
description:
(Fe) Iron Ore is a soft Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Isosap
description:
Isosap is a crystallized sap composed of long-chain polymers.

It is used in the production of rare, high grade materials.

name: Lead
description:
(Pb) Lead is a soft yet extremely dense Refined Metal.

It has a low Overheat Temperature and is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Lime
description:
(CaCO3) Lime is a mineral commonly found in Critter egg shells.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Mafic Rock
description:
Mafic Rock is a variation of Igneous Rock that is rich in Iron.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Mud
description:
A mixture of Dirt and Water.

Can be separated into its base elements using a Sludge Press.

name: Neutronium
description:
(Nt) Neutronium is a mysterious and extremely resilient element.

It cannot be excavated by any Duplicant mining tool.

name: Nickel
description:
(Ni) Nickel is a conductive Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Nickel Ore
description:
(Ni) Nickel Ore is a conductive Metal.

It can be refined into Nickel and is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Niobium
description: (Nb) Niobium is a rare metal with many practical applications in metallurgy and superconductor Research.

name: Obsidian
description: Obsidian is a brittle composite of volcanic Glass.

name: Oxylite
description:
(Ir3O2) Oxylite is a chemical compound that slowly emits breathable Oxygen.

Excavating Oxylite increases its emission rate, but depletes the ore more rapidly.

name: Packed Snow
description:
(H2O) Snow is a mass of loose, crystalline ice particles.

It becomes Water when melted.

name: Pearl
description:
A perfectly smooth gem.

It can be eaten by Seaquines or used as an attractive Construction Material.

name: Peat
description:
Peat is a densely packed material made up of partially decomposed organic matter.

It is a combustible fuel, useful in Power production.

name: Phosphorite
description: Phosphorite is a composite of sedimentary rock, saturated with phosphate.

name: Plastic
description:
(C3H6)n Plastic is a thermoplastic polymer.

It is useful for constructing a variety of advanced buildings and equipment.

name: Plastium
description:
Plastium is an advanced thermoplastic polymer made from Thermium, Plastic and Brackwax.

It is highly heat-resistant and suitable for use in space buildings.

name: Plywood
description:
Plywood is a good source of Heat and Power.

Its insulation properties make it a useful Construction Material.

name: Polluted Brine Ice
description: Polluted Brine Ice is a murky, concentrated solution of Salt dissolved in Polluted Water and frozen into a Solid state.

name: Polluted Dirt
description:
Polluted Dirt is unprocessed biological waste.

It emits Polluted Oxygen over time.

name: Polluted Ice
description: Polluted Ice is dirty, unfiltered water frozen into a Solid state.

name: Polluted Mud
description:
A mixture of Polluted Dirt and Polluted Water.

Can be separated into its base elements using a Sludge Press.

name: Pyrite
description:
(FeS2) Pyrite is a conductive Metal.

Also known as "Fool's Gold", is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Radium
description:
(Ra) Radium is a Light emitting radioactive substance.

It is useful as a Power source.

name: Refined Carbon
description: (C) Refined carbon is solid element purified from raw Coal.

name: Refined Phosphorus
description: (P) Refined Phosphorus is a chemical element in its Solid state.

name: Regolith
description:
Regolith is a sandy substance composed of the various particles that collect atop terrestrial objects.

It is useful as a Filtration Medium.

name: Rubber
description:
Rubber is a viscoelastic Solid made from vulcanized Latex.

It can be used to make Gaskets.

name: Rust
description:
Rust is an iron oxide that forms from the breakdown of Iron.

It is useful in some Oxygen production processes.

name: Salt
description:
(NaCl) Salt, also known as sodium chloride, is an edible chemical compound.

When refined, it can be eaten with meals to increase Duplicant Morale.

name: Sand
description:
Sand is a composite of granular rock.

It is useful as a Filtration Medium.

name: Sandstone
description:
Sandstone is a composite of relatively soft sedimentary rock.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Sedimentary Rock
description:
Sedimentary Rock is a hardened composite of sediment layers.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Shale
description:
Shale is a brittle composite of sediment layers.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Siltstone
description:
Siltstone is a chalky mudrock made primarily of compressed silt.

It is useful as a Construction Material.

name: Slime
description:
Slime is a thick biomixture of algae, fungi, and mucopolysaccharides.

It can be distilled into Algae and emits Polluted Oxygen once dug up.

name: Snow
description:
(H2O) Snow is a mass of loose, crystalline ice particles.

It becomes Water when melted.

name: Solid Carbon Dioxide
description: (CO2) Carbon Dioxide is an unbreathable compound in a Solid state.

name: Solid Chlorine
description: (Cl) Chlorine is a natural Germ-killing element in a Solid state.

name: Solid Ethanol
description:
(C2H6O) Solid Ethanol is an advanced chemical compound.

It can be used as a highly effective fuel source when burned.

name: Solid Gunk
description: Solid Gunk is the built-up grime and grit produced by Duplicants' bionic mechanisms, which has been frozen into a Solid state.

name: Solid Hydrogen
description: (H) Solid Hydrogen is the universe's most common element in a Solid state.

name: Solid Mercury
description: (Hg) Mercury is a rare Metal in a Solid state.

name: Solid Methane
description: (CH4) Methane is an alkane in a Solid state.

name: Solid Naphtha
description: Naphtha is a distilled hydrocarbon mixture in a Solid state.

name: Solid Nuclear Waste
description: Highly toxic solid full of Radioactive Contaminants.

name: Solid Oxygen
description: (O2) Solid Oxygen is a breathable element in a Solid state.

name: Solid Petroleum
description:
Petroleum is a Power source.

This selection is in a Solid state.

name: Solid Propane
description: (C3H8) Solid Propane is a natural gas in a Solid state.

name: Solid Resin
description:
Resin that has been cooled to a Solid state.

It can be treated to become Plastic in the Polymer Press.

name: Solid Sap
description:
Solidified goo harvested from a grumpy tree.

It is used in the production of Isosap.

name: Solid Super Coolant
description:
Super Coolant is an industrial-grade Fullerene coolant.

This selection is in a Solid state.

name: Solid Visco-Gel
description:
Visco-Gel is a polymer that has high surface tension when in Liquid form.

This selection is in a Solid state.

name: Steel
description: Steel is a Metal Alloy composed of iron and carbon.

name: Sucrose
description:
(C12H22O11) Sucrose is the raw form of sugar.

It can be used for cooking higher-quality Food.

name: Sulfur
description:
(S) Sulfur is a common chemical element and byproduct of Natural Gas production.

This selection is in a Solid state.

name: Tallow
description: A chunk of raw grease that can be used in Food production or industrial processes.

name: Thermium
description: Thermium is an industrial metal alloy formulated to maximize Heat Transfer and thermal dispersion.

name: Tungsten
description:
(W) Tungsten is an extremely tough crystalline Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Uranium Ore
description:
(U) Uranium Ore is a highly Radioactive substance.

It can be refined into fuel for research reactors.

name: Wolframite
description:
((Fe,Mn)WO4) Wolframite is a dense Metallic element in a Solid state.

It is a source of Tungsten and is suitable for building Power systems.

name: Wood
description:
Wood is a good source of Heat and Power.

Its insulation properties and positive Decor also make it a useful Construction Material.

name: Zinc
description: (Zn) Zinc is a very malleable Metal Alloy.

name: Zinc Ore
description:
(Zn) Zinc Ore is a malleable raw Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.
